description: t.a locks m at 0 and holds it until 300. t.b (from 10) waits with lock_until deadline 100: its deadline Sleep registers a timer on the first poll, fires at 100, and t.b times out, leaving the line. t.c (from 20) waits with deadline 1000 and is handed the lock at 300 (its Sleep is dropped: timer cancelled). At 500, t.d's lock_until with deadline 400 times out on its first poll even though the lock is free (the Sleep is polled before the lock, sync/mutex.rs:560-564) and registers no timer; its lock_until with deadline 900 takes the free lock at once, after the Sleep registered its timer, which is then cancelled.
